arStrings.szText:
Completing a {c_important}Whisper{/c} has a chance to trigger a {c_important}Whisper Ambush{/c}. 

These enemies have a chance to burst out the contents of a {c_important}Collection of Chaos{/c} when slain.
{icon:Marker_Season_Green_font,2.5}At Rank {c_number}5{/c} with the {c_important}Splinter of Destruction{/c}, {c_important}Whisper Ambush{/c} triggers more often.
